column1: # Repo → layer/project manifest. Tab-separated. Comments and short rows ignored.
# Read by AIOS/Systems/hooks/lib.sh (aios_lookup). Maps a code repo's DIRECTORY
# NAME to the identity layer it belongs to and the project slug its knowledge
# The layer is NEVER guessed. A repo that isn't listed here is a silent no-op:
# the SessionStart hook loads no context and the Stop hook writes no digest.
# That is the safe default — add a row deliberately.
# Column 1 must match `basename` of the repo checkout, not its remote name.
# Column 2 must match a layer slug in AIOS/Systems/layers.tsv.
